memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine review of type 2 diabetes, depression and insomnia.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, weight 78 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 27.6 (obese). Pulse regular, lungs clear, no peripheral neuropathy.
IMPRESSION: Diabetes uncontrolled (HbA1c pending), depression stable on sertraline, insomnia poorly controlled.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD. Continue sertraline 50 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Order fasting lipids, fasting glucose, HbA1c, urine albumin-creatinine, TSH, vitamin B12, PHQ-9, ISI, haemoglobin. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, bloody stools, worsening sadness or suicidal thoughts.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow‑up on diabetes and insomnia; reports daytime fatigue.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/84 mmHg, weight 77.5 kg, BMI 27.5 (overweight). Feet intact, no retinopathy signs on brief fundoscopy.
IMPRESSION: HbA1c improved to 7.6%; lipids unchanged; insomnia worse (ISI 22). Depression stable (PHQ‑9 7).
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current diabetic regimen. Increase trazodone to 75 mg HS for insomnia; add mirtazapine 15 mg HS as needed for sleep. Reinforce diet (≤1800 kcal/day) and brisk walk 30 mins daily. Order repeat fasting lipids, HbA1c, urine ACR, TSH, vitamin B12, PHQ‑9, ISI, haemoglobin. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, worsening low mood, suicidal ideation, or painful feet.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Dilated fundus examination: No microaneurysms, no haemorrhages, no exudates. Macula appears normal. No signs of diabetic retinopathy. Recommend repeat in 12 months.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Autumn review; requests influenza vaccine.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/82 mmHg, weight 77 kg, BMI 27.3 (overweight). No acute distress.
IMPRESSION: Diabetes stable, insomnia improved on trazodone 75 mg + PRN mirtazapine, depression stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Administered inactivated influenza vaccine (0.5 mL IM) today. Continue all current medicines. Advise low‑salt diet, regular exercise. Order fasting lipids, HbA1c, urine ACR, TSH, vitamin B12, PHQ‑9, ISI, haemoglobin if clinically indicated. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, new rash after vaccine, worsening mood or suicidal thoughts.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine review; notes increased thirst and polyuria over past month.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/88 mmHg, weight 78.2 kg, BMI 27.7 (overweight). Pedal pulses present, no ulcer.
IMPRESSION: HbA1c risen to 8.0%; lipids borderline; depression worsening (PHQ‑9 12). Insomnia better (ISI 14).
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase metformin to 850 mg BD. Continue glimepiride, sitagliptin, empagliflozin. Change antidepressant: stop sertraline, start escitalopram 10 mg OD. Continue melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS (reduce from 75 mg). Order fasting lipids, HbA1c, urine ACR, TSH, vitamin B12, PHQ‑9, ISI, haemoglobin. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, worsening sadness, suicidal thoughts, or severe hypoglycaemia.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow‑up after medication change; reports low mood and poor concentration.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/86 mmHg, weight 77.9 kg, BMI 27.4 (overweight). No focal neurology.
IMPRESSION: Depression worsening despite escitalopram (PHQ‑9 15). Diabetes HbA1c 7.8%; lipids stable. Insomnia controlled (ISI 10).
ARRANGEMENTS: Add mirtazapine 15 mg HS nightly (continue as needed). Continue escitalopram 10 mg OD, metformin 850 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Order repeat TSH, vitamin B12, PHQ‑9, ISI, haemoglobin, fasting lipids, HbA1c, urine ACR. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, worsening low mood, suicidal thoughts, or severe hypoglycaemia.
